Remark
[nonexact powers of the Kähler form]

Source: petersen:page-0376 ↗ rem:pet-ch9-poincare-duality 1. ch9:9.6.15Let $\omega $ be the parallel nondegenerate Kähler form of a closed Kähler manifold. Prove that each wedge power $\omega ^k=\omega \wedge \cdots \wedge \omega $ is closed and nonexact. Use that $\omega ^{\dim M/2}$ is proportional to the volume form, and conclude that every even homology group is nonzero.
